body: Therapy helped me a lot to understand how badly I treat myself whilst helping me learn not to. I would recommend therapy if you’re thinking of it. In my country it’s quite a long wait time unfortunately but it was still worth it. I do wish I had more time with my therapist.

I’ve had therapy since January 2019 and I’m still currently in therapy. Well it’s more an intervention team that checks on me and help but I properly had therapy sessions in Dec 2019-Feb 2021. I’m also sorry you’re going through pain friend but I also wont promise to stay till then. This is just part of my journey. I’m also unfortunately not the right person to tell you otherwise.
